description: A module to manage Pritunl users using the Pritunl API.

parameters.name: organization
parameters.description: The name of the organization the user is part of.

parameters.name: pritunl_api_secret
parameters.description: API Secret found in Administrators > USERNAME > API Secret.

parameters.name: pritunl_api_token
parameters.description: API Token of a Pritunl admin user. It needs to be enabled in Administrators > USERNAME > Enable Token Authentication.

parameters.name: pritunl_url
parameters.description: URL and port of the Pritunl server on which the API is enabled.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: If present, the module adds user user_name to the Pritunl organization. If absent, removes the user user_name from the Pritunl organization. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: user_disabled
parameters.description: Enable/Disable the user user_name. Choices: false true

parameters.name: user_email
parameters.description: Email address associated with the user user_name.

parameters.name: user_gravatar
parameters.description: Enable/Disable Gravatar usage for the user user_name. Choices: false true

parameters.name: user_groups
parameters.description: List of groups associated with the user user_name.

parameters.name: user_mac_addresses
parameters.description: Allowed MAC addresses for the user user_name.

parameters.name: user_name
parameters.description: Name of the user to create or delete from Pritunl.

parameters.name: user_type
parameters.description: Type of the user user_name. Choices: "client" ← (default) "server"

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: If certificates should be validated or not. This should never be set to false, except if you are very sure that your connection to the server can not be subject to a Man In The Middle attack. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Create the user Foo with email address foo@bar.com in MyOrg
  community.general.pritunl_user:
    state: present
    organization: MyOrg
    user_name: Foo
    user_email: foo@bar.com
    user_mac_addresses:
      - "00:00:00:00:00:99"

- name: Disable the user Foo but keep it in Pritunl
  community.general.pritunl_user:
    state: present
    organization: MyOrg
    user_name: Foo
    user_email: foo@bar.com
    user_disabled: true

- name: Make sure the user Foo is not part of MyOrg anymore
  community.general.pritunl_user:
    state: absent
    organization: MyOrg
    user_name: Foo

return_values.name: response
return_values.description: JSON representation of Pritunl Users. Returned: success Sample: {"audit": false, "auth_type": "google", "bypass_secondary": false, "client_to_client": false, "disabled": false, "dns_mapping": null, "dns_servers": null, "dns_suffix": null, "email": "foo@bar.com", "gravatar": true, "groups": ["foo", "bar"], "id": "5d070dafe63q3b2e6s472c3b", "name": "foo@acme.com", "network_links": [], "organization": "58070daee6sf342e6e4s2c36", "organization_name": "Acme", "otp_auth": true, "otp_secret": "35H5EJA3XB2$4CWG", "pin": false, "port_forwarding": [], "servers": []}
